facts.fact: Wound-share in ch 27: an original bite bleeds on the one bitten; on the partner it rises as a hot, shallow, weeping welt that does not open. Neela's calf bite bleeds and a welt rises on Devan's left calf. Madhavi's bite on Devan's thigh is a real wound and a welt rises on Neela's thigh.
Madhavi (brindled animal, one of the forty) does not break off when named, closes on Devan's thigh and draws blood; Neela weighs the packet and chooses not to read her page, and Madhavi lets go.
Chathu's plain-ink line on Vellan's contract leaf, 'Thirty. Release not to be granted. Sell to the crown when spent', has been written since Vellan's third contract.
Thilak brought Neela tea for nine days at the Resin House.
